pairs.why: Both are almost the same matte navy-lid striped box with a twisted rope, and neither has the soft glossy highlights the real cards have.
The only real difference is proportion (A is taller, B is squatter); rendering, color and finish match and are equally a bit flatter than the real cards.
A's rope handle is smoother and less fibrous, which matches the lessons' preference for smoother surfaces over texture; everything else is the same.
Both have the same twisted rope, matte lid and flat stripes, with no difference that matters.
The two are nearly identical; B's lid rim has a faint highlight, but it is too small to decide the pair.
A is only wider, and the finish, color and lighting are the same.
B's lid rim has a soft glossy highlight that comes a little closer to the polished toy finish of the real cards (vending machine, phone booth), while A's lid stays flat and matte.
A is squatter with wider stripes, but the materials, lighting and finish are effectively the same.
